parameters.sampling: LightFHE original sigma3.2 cutoff +/-4, corrected +/-39; Primus sigma3.2 discrete CDT +/-38; G2 refined rounded continuous Gaussian vs Primus truncated discrete Ziggurat.
parameters.input_ks: G1 none. G2 refined scalar 2048->636; Primus inverse extraction->ring KS->compact extraction (q=Q). Same L,b is not same noise distribution.
parameters.return: rank1 N2048, four-level full transformed GGSW (L,b)=(4,4); cbs_cmux adds encrypted t8 depth1 consumer; no scalar LWE return KS
parameters.classification: All cross-library comparisons are derived, not matched protocols. Within Primus precision pairs match declared parameters, consumer and seeds; auto-selected FFT plans may differ.

validation.primus: Both bits t8 CMux gate before timing, measured output checked after timing; prior B3 all-row diagnostics retained
validation.lightfhe: Each process three keys 42/43/44 x four inputs; full rows, 48 consumers and digit oracle checked; every timed GGSW equals previously consumed output
validation.refined: Each process three keys 42/43/44 x four inputs; full 96 row records, 48 real consumers plus two measured-output consumer checks; any mismatch panics
validation.interpretation: Repeated processes repeat fixed fixtures, not new independent security/DFR evidence; historical g/16 budget caveats remain
